lines.text: Celadon City:\nThe City of Rainbow Dreams
Celadon City Pokémon Gym\nGym Leader: Erika\r\nThe Nature-Loving Princess!
Celadon Condominiums
Celadon Department Store:\nYou’ll Be Sure to Find Whatever You Need!

Trainer Tips\c
X Accuracy boosts a Pokémon’s accuracy.
Dire Hit boosts the likelihood of critical hits.\c
If you’re in the market for items, the Celadon
Department Store is your one-stop shop!

Trainer Tips\c
Guard Spec. protects Pokémon from having
their stats lowered if you use one in a battle.\c
If you’re in the market for items, the Celadon
Department Store is your one-stop shop!
Rocket Game Corner:\nA Playground for Grown-Ups and Kids Alike!
My Koffing is the best partner ever!\nIt spews out Poison Gas when it gets angry...\r\nbut it’s usually very sweet—I promise!
Haha! This Gym is great!\nIt’s full of strong Trainers!

Celadon City takes pride in its efforts to keep
itself clean and beautiful.\c
The area around the Game Corner is a different
story, though. It gets a bit rough around there.

Awww...
I lost again at the Game Corner!\c
I guess the people who are so good at the games
there must be putting in more effort than I do...
This is my trusted pal, Poliwrath.\c\nIt evolved from a Poliwhirl when I used\na Water Stone on it.
POLIWRATH: Ribi ribit!
What’re you staring at? Get lost.\nEither you leave or I’ll make you leave!
What d’you think you’re doing running around\nhere?! We’re Team Rocket, don’t you know!

My Jigglypuff has an Adamant Nature!\c
It’s easy to raise its Attack stat but not so easy
to raise its Sp. Atk.
Its Double Slap is a real slap in the face!
JIGGLYPUFF: Fhun fhun!
KOFFING: Gasss...
It’s a strange vehicle with a bunch of balloons\nattached to it!
All right. Let’s go to the restaurant, shall we?
Grandma, I’m hungry!
Oh? Shouldn’t I be able to reach the Gym\nfrom here?
RATTATA: Gnaw gnaw!
GLOOM: Mehhh...
Handmade Pokémon accessories! Go take\na look on the fifth floor of the department store!
